Product Description

Elevate the aesthetics and functionality of your home or business with this pack of 2 amber glass soap dispensers. With a sleek design and high-quality materials, these dispensers are perfect for any space, from bathrooms and kitchens to professional settings. They include stainless steel pumps and silicone bases for durability and safety.

  • CONTENTS: Includes 2 amber glass dispensers with 500 cm³ capacity, with black lacquered stainless steel pump, removable silicone base and 6 high contrast waterproof labels.
  • USES: Ideal for dispensing all kinds of liquid soaps. Its sophisticated design is perfect for bathrooms, kitchens or businesses, bringing a touch of elegance.
  • RESISTANT: The silicone base provides great adhesion to surfaces, even wet, and protects against impact breakage or accidental drops.
  • HIGH QUALITY: Each component (bottle, silicone base and pump) has been carefully selected to offer the best quality on the market, ensuring durability and functionality.
  • PRESENTATION: Comes in a protective box with the glass bottles wrapped in a bubble bag to ensure your safety during transport.
